items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that the formal completion f_{/T} of a modification smooth over the complement of T is rig-smooth (source lines 6122-6183, label lemma-smooth-gives-rig-smooth). The solver must build a double etale affine covering, transport the rig-smooth property through the morphism-level locality lemma, and run the affine algebra reduction identifying the completions as I-adic; the double-covering bookkeeping across completions is the substantive part. Allowed background: the completion cartesianity discussion and the cited properties and formal spaces lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
